fullDescription: A cinematic dark-mode design system characterized by 'Liquid Glass' UI components

structured.summary: Observe is a high-fidelity design system utilizing a dark-mode, glassmorphic layout. It pairs the elegant Instrument Serif font with clean sans-serif UI elements. The design is anchored by 'Liquid Glass' containers that use background-blur and complex gradient borders to create a premium, tactile feel. It is designed to sit on top of high-contrast background videos without sacrificing legibility through the strategic use of multi-layered text shadows.

special_ui_components.description: A sophisticated glass panel with light-reactive borders.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply 'backdrop-filter: blur(8px)' and 'background: rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'. Use a pseudo-element (::before) to create a 1.4px border with a multi-stop linear gradient (white-to-transparent-to-white) and apply 'mask-composite: exclude' so only the border remains. Add an inner box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1).

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain the 0.5x playback rate for background video to preserve the 'calm' atmosphere. MUST: Use the video for the hero section. Legibility must be handled solely via text-shadows and glass panels. MUST: Keep the subline on a single line on desktop to maintain the horizontal balance of the hero section.
